profile.headline: Software Engineer at DPI Information Services
profile.summary:
Full stack web developer with experience in Ruby and JavaScript frameworks, passionate about learning new skills and applying them to real world solutions. My background in automation and business development provides me with exceptional communication and project management skills as well as an aptitude for creative and scrappy solutions to big problems, which translates well to writing code and working in teams.

Proficient Languages: C/C++, Java, React, C#, JavaScript,  Python, Ruby, PHP, SQL, HTML

positions.title: General Manager
positions.description: Full operational Manager for the property. Ran everything from the financials to the inventory. Have years of experience with leadership and managerial roles.
